articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement over GPT-5 on complex software engineering tasks requiring cross-modal understanding, with latency reduced to near-GPT-4 Turbo levels through aggressive distillation and speculative decoding.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Graduate-Level Scientific Reasoning
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scores above 90% on the GPQA Diamond benchmark and demonstrates significant gains in multi-step mathematical proof generation and experimental design in chemistry and biology. The model leverages a new mixture-of-experts architecture with over 50 specialized expert modules and a refined RLHF pipeline trained with feedback from domain scientists.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in select Gigafactory production lines for material handling and quality inspection tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models that allow natural language task reassignment by floor supervisors without reprogramming.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Whole-Body Predictive Control
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform powered by a new whole-body model predictive control stack that enables real-time dynamic replanning at 500Hz. The system can recover from significant perturbations while carrying payloads up to 25kg, and integrates with standard ROS 2 Jazzy middleware for fleet orchestration in warehouse and construction environments.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Research on Constitutional AI Scaling Laws and Alignment Tax Reduction
articles.summary: Anthropic released a detailed technical paper showing that alignment overhead—the performance cost of safety training—shrinks predictably with model scale under their Constitutional AI framework. At their largest model scales the alignment tax drops below 2% on capability benchmarks, challenging the assumption that safety and capability are fundamentally at odds.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has entered risk production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) gate-all-around transistor process, roughly one quarter ahead of its original roadmap. Early test chips show a 20% performance gain and 30% power reduction over N2, which could significantly benefit next-generation AI accelerator designs from Nvidia, AMD, and Apple slated for late 2027.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Hits 1,000-Cycle Milestone in EV-Format Cells
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its multi-layer solid-state lithium-metal cells have surpassed 1,000 charge-discharge cycles while retaining over 90% capacity at automotive-relevant discharge rates. This milestone addresses the key durability concern that has delayed solid-state battery commercialization and puts the company on track for its partnership deliveries to Volkswagen's Scout EV line in 2027.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production and On-Device Foundation Models
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at a reported $15 billion valuation, with the funding earmarked for building its first dedicated humanoid robot manufacturing facility in Texas and expanding its on-device multimodal foundation model team. The company claims its Figure 03 robot can autonomously learn novel manipulation tasks from fewer than 10 demonstrations using a proprietary few-shot imitation learning framework.
